name: balka
description: The six-stage AI-native SDLC playbook as commands, skills and opt-in hooks: intent, design with Gherkin scenarios and red bindings, plan then build until green, a fresh verifier, a Copilot-reviewed pull request, and a watch on everything it builds: each project chooses how it knows things keep running and which agent helps when they break. Plus a reflect step that turns a repo's corrections into the next version. Project-agnostic; every artefact is plain markdown in the project's own git.
